text.hi: सवाल को indirect में बदलते समय: said to → asked, सवाल का क्रम सीधे वाक्य जैसा, और ? हट जाता है। Ramu said to Mohan, "Where are you going?" → Ramu asked Mohan where he was going.
text.hinglish: Sawaal ko indirect mein badalte samay: said to → asked, sawaal ka kram seedhe vaakya jaisa, aur ? hat jaata hai. Ramu said to Mohan, "Where are you going?" → Ramu asked Mohan where he was going.
text.en: When reporting a question: said to → asked, the words go in normal sentence order, and the ? goes away. Ramu said to Mohan, "Where are you going?" → Ramu asked Mohan where he was going.

text.hi: किताब: एक ही शब्द के दो रूप। sweet (मीठा, विशेषण) → sweetness (मिठास, संज्ञा)। I enjoy the sweetness of honey.
text.hinglish: Kitaab: ek hi shabd ke do roop. sweet (meetha, visheshan) → sweetness (mithaas, sangya). I enjoy the sweetness of honey.
text.en: The book: two forms of one word. sweet (adjective) → sweetness (noun). I enjoy the sweetness of honey.
